state:
Goal `tools-server`: two of the chapter's eight features have their proofs,
`tools:server/behind-a-proxy-trusted-proxies` and `tools:server/mounts-which-file-answers-a-request`.
`bun nv proofs --owed --group tools:server` lists the six still owed. Nothing is blocked.

The mounts proofs found one bug on the real server, fixed in the same session: with `dispatch = "path"`
or `static = true`, Windows opened a file for a URL that wrote its name with a dot or a space added, and
every platform opened one for a doubled or a trailing slash. `OnDisk::file` and `under` in
`crates/nvs-server/src/mount.rs` now answer only for the name the disk holds, and the chapter's
§ *How a request resolves* says so.

A `.nvst` case cannot name a mount (`crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs:67`), so a case for a mount feature
pins what the root mount reads; a `.nvsr` file beside an example or an attack names one with `--MOUNT--`.
`crates/nvs-server/src/mount.rs` and `crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs` are added to the pack's `modules`.
